scientific_limitations: Only one-world Gödel-valued Kripke models with one propositional letter and no named intermediate truth constants.
Modal equivalence means pointwise equality of truth degrees, not just equality of designated values.
The classical 342-element two-generated free Gödel algebra is known; novelty is claimed only for the 60-element box fragment and joint sharp depth-one classification.
Potential earlier equivalent calculations in specialized modal algebra literature are not excluded.
title: Sharp depth-one collapse and a \(60:342\) expressive gap on singleton fuzzy Gödel frames
